title: Grateful Dead Live at Miami Arena on 1994-04-06
source: flac16/48kHz; Master Audience Recording & Transfer by Ray Ackerman: AKG 460B/CK63 ULS > AKG B18 phantom power unit > Panasonic SV250 > DAT (OTS); Transfer info: Tascam DA 30 mkii > Microtrack ii > wavelab 5 > WAV 16/48

ai_review.summary: Average show with a solid setlist and good Phil Lesh moments, but no recording details and overall negative impression
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds the concert only average, hampered by a poor venue despite an outstanding setlist that includes a strong Broken Arrow from Phil, a West LA Fadeaway, and a cool intro to The Wheel. No comments are made about the audio source or sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one low‑star review; shows mixed praise for a few songs but overall disappointment and no recording info, leading to a rating near the reviewer’s 2‑star score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments about sound quality or source; reviewers did not discuss audio clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer calls the setlist outstanding despite an average performance overall, highlighting a few strong moments.

band_member_comments.Phil: Kicks ass as usual on Broken Arrow
